capabilities: Render any base as a month calendar grouped by a date property
List upcoming notes in a chronological agenda view
Choose any frontmatter property as the date and set week start
Parse varied date formats including ISO, compact, timestamps and moment objects
Count notes without valid dates in a footer hint
disambiguation: Not a standalone calendar or daily-notes tool; it only adds view layouts to existing .base files.
extras: Some planned features (multi-property filters, agenda grouping, custom chip templates) are marked as a paid 'Pro' tier in the v0.3 roadmap. Includes full Chinese documentation.
intentEvidence: Calendar and agenda views for Obsidian Bases — group any base by a date property
problem: Bases ships table, card and board layouts but no way to see a set of dated notes arranged by time on a calendar.

relations.evidence: Make sure the core Bases plugin is enabled

summary: Calendar and agenda views for Obsidian Bases that group a base's notes by a date property on a month grid.
